repeat: It took three pieces of paper to earn this one. That is the exchange rate here.
It entitled me to see a sheet of paper that says nothing. I have seen it. It said nothing.

LISTEN_TO.say: Paper, very stiff. It has been starched by procedure.
repeat: Nothing. It has done the one thing it was for.
